summary.description: Two or three sentences a human reads instead of the transcript. What you looked at, what you found, what you are proposing. No preamble.

actions.description: Everything you want done. An empty array is a valid and common result — a backlog that needs nothing is the goal, not a failure.

target.description: Issue number this acts on. Use 0 for create-issue, and for escalate when the blocker is not about one issue.

why.description: The evidence for this action, citing what you read: an issue number, a file path, a date, a command output. If you cannot cite it, do not propose the action. This is the rule that separates a role from a bot with opinions.

body.description: comment / create-issue / close-issue / escalate: the text to post. Terse, next-actions-first, no preamble, no closing summary.

title.description: create-issue: the issue title. Conventional-commit style is not required here, but it must name the work, not the topic.

labels.description: label / unlabel / create-issue: labels to add or remove. Must appear in registry.json labels.allowed.

field.description: set-field: the Project v2 field name, e.g. Status, Priority, Size.

unresolved.description: Things you could not determine and what you would need to determine them. Say this out loud rather than guessing — an unresolved item is a finding, a guess is a defect.
